#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class LightScanner {
    BufferedReader* reader;
    StringTokenizer* tokenizer;
public:
    LightScanner(InputStream& in) {
        reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(in));
        tokenizer = nullptr;
    }
    string string() {
        if (tokenizer == nullptr || !tokenizer->hasMoreTokens()) {
            try {
                tokenizer = new StringTokenizer(reader->readLine());
            } catch (IOException& e) {
                throw UncheckedIOException(e);
            }
        }
        return tokenizer->nextToken();
    }
    int ints() {
        return stoi(string());
    }
    ~LightScanner() {
        delete reader;
        delete tokenizer;
    }
};

class LightWriter : public AutoCloseable {
    Writer* out;
    bool autoflush;
    bool breaked;
public:
    LightWriter(Writer* out) : out(out), autoflush(false), breaked(true) {}
    LightWriter(OutputStream& out) {
        this->out = new BufferedWriter(new OutputStreamWriter(out, Charset::defaultCharset()));
        autoflush = false;
        breaked = true;
    }
    LightWriter& print(char c) {
        try {
            out->write(c);
            breaked = false;
        } catch (IOException& ex) {
            throw UncheckedIOException(ex);
        }
        return *this;
    }
    LightWriter& print(const string& s) {
        try {
            out->write(s, 0, s.length());
            breaked = false;
        } catch (IOException& ex) {
            throw UncheckedIOException(ex);
        }
        return *this;
    }
    LightWriter& ans(const string& s) {
        if (!breaked) {
            print(' ');
        }
        return print(s);
    }
    LightWriter& ans(int i) {
        return ans(to_string(i));
    }
    LightWriter& ln() {
        print("\n");
        breaked = true;
        if (autoflush) {
            try {
                out->flush();
            } catch (IOException& ex) {
                throw UncheckedIOException(ex);
            }
        }
        return *this;
    }
    void close() {
        try {
            out->close();
        } catch (IOException& ex) {
            throw UncheckedIOException(ex);
        }
    }
    ~LightWriter() {
        delete out;
    }
};

class CMisterBAndBoringGame {
public:
    void solve(int testNumber, LightScanner& in, LightWriter& out) {
        int a = in.ints(), b = in.ints(), l = in.ints() - 1, r = in.ints() - 1;
        int min_val = 26;
        for (char p = 'a'; p <= 'z'; p++) {
            for (char q = (char)('a' + a); q <= 'z'; q++) {
                string rep;
                for (int i = 0; i < a; i++) rep += (char)(i + 'a');
                for (int i = 0; i < b; i++) rep += p;
                for (int i = 0; i < a; i++) {
                    bool f[26] = {false};
                    for (int j = b; j < a + b + i; j++) {
                        f[rep[j] - 'a'] = true;
                    }
                    for (int j = 0; j < 26; j++) {
                        if (!f[j]) {
                            rep += (char)(j + 'a');
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                for (int i = 0; i < b; i++) rep += q;

                bool flag[26] = {false};
                if (r - l + 1 >= 100000) {
                    for (int i = 0; i < (int)rep.length(); i++) {
                        flag[rep[i] - 'a'] = true;
                    }
                } else {
                    for (int i = l; i <= r; i++) {
                        flag[rep[i % rep.length()] - 'a'] = true;
                    }
                }

                int ans = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) if (flag[i]) ans++;
                min_val = min(ans, min_val);
            }
        }
        out.ans(min_val).ln();
    }
};

int main() {
    InputStream inputStream = System.in;
    OutputStream outputStream = System.out;
    LightScanner in(inputStream);
    LightWriter out(outputStream);
    CMisterBAndBoringGame solver;
    solver.solve(1, in, out);
    out.close();
    return 0;
}
